panels.description: Falcon maintenance room. Sitara and Nayah stand beside a directional borehole map; unauthorized branches descend toward resource markers. Leave upper-left for a caption and upper-right for a permit caption.

A physical manifest beside a concealed waste chute shows overwritten entries. Nayah photographs it while Sitara studies the page. Leave separated upper-left and upper-right balloon zones, both fully inside the panel, with a clear central gap.
Two synchronized displays show drilling vibration below and ice-motion plots above. A red timestamp fragment crosses the maintenance sheet. Leave the top edge clear for a balloon.
The TJ turns toward a sealed archive slot containing paper records, a dead data wafer, and a warning fragment. Leave upper-middle for the archive caption and upper-right for TJ dialogue.

items.speaker: NAYAH
items.text: That is not an ice-core manifest.

items.speaker: SITARA
items.text: It is pretending to be one.

items.speaker: SITARA
items.text: The vibration is local. The instability is not.
